newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all weaker, slow ahead of Easter.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all weaker, slow ahead of Easter.

text.p: NWE oil products were all weakened on Friday by easier crude. Most market were slow ahead of the Easter break.
High sulphur fuel barge prices fell as one trader sold large volumes at $86 fob ARA. High and low sulphur cargo prices were steady with markets lifeless ahead of Easter
Gasoline was pressured $4 a tonne lower on the back of heavy refinery selling.
Gas oil was hit severely losing up $5.75 a tonne on futures and easier premiums bar marginally firmer heating oil barges.
